- Validate input: ensure number is an int within 1–1000; raise ValueError otherwise. Special-case 1000 -> "m".
- Define ordered mapping of decimal values to Roman numerals: [(1000,'M'), (900,'CM'), (500,'D'), (400,'CD'), (100,'C'), (90,'XC'), (50,'L'), (40,'XL'), (10,'X'), (9,'IX'), (5,'V'), (4,'IV'), (1,'I')].
- Greedy conversion: iterate mapping from largest to smallest, append symbol while value <= remaining number, decrement number accordingly; join result and lower-case before returning.
